node.title: C_XR content at k=3 (grounded): post-strip extremals are fixed-core/fixed-hole structures
node.statement: After stripping paid quotient strata, the k=3 inverse class C_XR consists exactly of fixed-core and fixed-hole (first-eigenspace) structures. Grounded by E11's stripped dictionary scan (J(16,8), J(32,16): only such structures top the E_3 lists) and #191's proved k=1 dictator extremals. This SPECIFIES the inverse theorem's target class — xr_inverse now has a concrete statement to prove rather than an unknown class to discover.
